notes.title: MEET THE BORDERLINE STATION
notes.notes:
While creating the main environment plans for a space station that was far from Earth or any human supply center, I always imagined a poor environment. As it is the main space for our planet Ukknar, the station had to had last gen equipment. But that never meant it  would be comfortable for an operators daily needs. Modules designed for the operator(s) were old and and used to the last line. Well, the mission comes first after all, right?

The modules are slightly modified for use in space, but still, most of them were used on other colonies for years before they became what they are today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767753/05a5f9a4d94d351598ce300624b37e41af0b80ee.png[/img]

It never offers more than the mission as an operator demands.

[i]Workshop
Energy Distribution
Life Support 
Reactors
Storage
Living Quarter(s)
Kitchen
Operation Center
Tower Control Chamber[/i]
 
What more does it need? After all, you can't have an arcade room orbiting a planet that is commonly known with its military operations against [ [strike]aliens[/strike] ].

------------

[h2]Todays New Component[/h2]

The Life Support Module has three important functions for the station:
[b]1-Station Air Quality Controller[/b]
2-Plant Growth and Oxygen Generation Facilities 
3-Water Tank Facilities

1.1- Gas Control Console
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767753/99284809da787e6f3c0fe2ba79426646de814223.png[/img]

This swappable console controls the main gas control machine. To pump a certain gas, you just select your desired room from the main console and start pumping from here. [url=https://twitter.com/eyp_krkmaz/status/1732497831192052014]It works perfectly doesn't it?[/url]

notes.title: ATTENTION OPERATORS!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Welcome to my first weekly development news post! I'm thrilled to share the current state and future plans for Borderline Enigma.

In this initial community post for my debut title, I'd like to share a bit about myself and bring you up to speed on the development process. As a solo developer, I hold high expectations for the future. My journey began in the summer of 2022 as I immersed myself in learning Unreal Engine until June 2023, when I began crafting the first elements of Borderline Enigma. During this period, the game primarily focused on core features, drawing inspiration from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315980/Tin_Can/]Tin Can[/url]. But at the end, it turned out I was inspired more from games like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/239030/Papers_Please/]Papers Please[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147550/Not_For_Broadcast/]Not For Broadcast[/url].

Over the following months, I experimented with various ideas and prototyped numerous mechanics, although not all made it to the semi-final development stage. Simultaneously, progress was made towards a functional gameplay (or at least, that was my intention).

Initially, my first title was meant to be a game conceived in the second quarter of 2021. However, its complexity proved too demanding for a first-time developer. Despite this setback, I held onto the idea. The world and story I created provided the perfect foundation for expanding the universe, with certain characters too compelling to discard. This became the baseline for Borderline Enigma's story and world-building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767753/1545de63cc6900b98417a7354b302ae1706e570f.png[/img]

Humans made tremendous leaps forward in the following years. With less conflict on Earth, attention shifted to the galaxy, leading to prosperity through expansion. While not everyone embraced the change, it became the reality for the species. Mineral-rich and promising planets were surveyed, some colonized, and others were already home to various inhabitants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767753/e7f6b6fe04e77afb07433d43c3e3fc89f93efab4.png[/img]

In the midst of all this, you find yourself operating a listening post above the planet "Ukknar." Everything is new, and your training wasn't detailed enough for this hostile environment. Yet, here you are, alone in deep space, navigating consoles that could be a game-changer for Ukknar.

This game aims to tell a story, but more than that, it's about a story with possibilities, uncertainties and some dilemmas.

My next post will be more towards the actual gameplay rather than me talking nonsense. So, stay tuned and take care!

See ya!
